title: Flight Tracks
description: Historic aircraft flight tracks derived from Automatic Dependent Surveillance–Broadcast (ADS-B) position reports captured by a network of ground receivers across the contiguous United States. Each record represents a single flight as a GIS linestring geometry with associated ICAO identifier, aircraft type, altitude above ground level at start and end, and timestamps. Data is partitioned into daily Parquet files spanning 2023–2026.
